_security_notes.xlsx: Known prototype pollution vulnerability (GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6, GHSA-5pgg-2g8v-p4x9). No upstream fix available. Mitigated by server-side file type validation, size limits, and Multer filtering. Required for Excel import feature.
_security_notes.tar: Critical vulnerabilities via @mapbox/node-pre-gyp transitive dependency. No direct fix available without upstream resolution. Not exploitable in this context as tar extraction is not exposed to user input.
